verdict.rationale: Alacritty is a locally run terminal emulator. Its INSTALL docs cover building it from source (`cargo build --release`) and installing it yourself (`cargo install alacritty`) on BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows, and community users report building and rebuilding it themselves, so the user runs the whole product on their own machines. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, and a working signed macOS binary path (the Homebrew cask is disabled over Gatekeeper, so macOS users must build from source or bypass Gatekeeper).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The supported platforms currently consist of BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows.
Alacritty can be installed by using various package managers on Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows.
